@if(equals(string(activity('Lookup_Publication_State').output.firstRow.should_copy), '1'), concat('SELECT public.sp_atualizar_etl_consumer_control(''adf_powerbi'', ''', item().entityName, ''', ', string(activity('Lookup_Publication_State').output.firstRow.publication_version), ', ''', activity('Lookup_Publication_State').output.firstRow.run_id, ''', ''SUCCESS'') AS last_consumed_version'), 'SELECT 0 AS last_consumed_version')
